name: twostorycaptions
description: TwoStoryCaptions: an offline caption planner, packaged with Capacitor

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.icons: python3 scripts/make-icon-sources.py && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#0059FF' --splashBackgroundColor '#F0F5FF' && python3 scripts/make-icon-sources.py --legacy
